meta.name: dream-video-prompt-generator
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在制作数字人带货短视频时，用本技能一键生成即梦视频中英文提示词。依托四大智能体协同与专属公式，确保人物与情绪高度一致，完美适配5s带货场景，高效产出高质量分镜脚本，让视频制作事半功倍！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入带货主题，生成数字人短视频的中英文分镜提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是电商运营或内容创作者，常做数字人带货短视频却苦于写提示词。
copy.tagline_en: Turn product info into bilingual video prompts for digital-human selling clips.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create digital-human selling videos and struggle with prompt writing.

howto.what: 生成小省导购员数字人带货视频的即梦提示词，默认5幕、每幕5秒，输出中英文对照版本，并附上Suno音乐与AI绘画提示词。
howto.when: 当你需要生成小省导购员数字人带货视频的提示词时触发；备好场景类型（产品推荐、价格对比、促销活动等）、情绪基调与幕次即可开始。

say.text: 帮我生成5幕产品推荐的数字人带货提示词
say.note: 按公式输出中英文对照提示词

say.text: 把情绪基调改成紧迫热情，重新出一版提示词
say.note: 光影与氛围会随情绪调整

say.text: 顺带给这五幕配上Suno音乐和AI绘画提示词
say.note: 输出与即梦提示词同源的跨工具提示词

howto.what_en: Generates Jimeng video prompts for the Xiao Sheng shopping-guide digital human: default 5 scenes of 5s each, in Chinese and English, plus matching Suno music and AI painting prompts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need prompts for a Xiao Sheng digital human product-selling video. Prepare the scene type (product recommendation, price comparison, promotion, etc.), emotion tone and scene count.

say_en.text: Generate 5-scene prompts for a product recommendation digital human video.
say_en.note: Outputs Chinese and English prompts per scene.

say_en.text: Change the emotion tone to urgent and enthusiastic and redo the prompts.
say_en.note: Light and atmosphere follow the emotion tone.

say_en.text: Also give me the Suno music and AI painting prompts for these five scenes.
say_en.note: Outputs cross-tool prompts from the same source.
